component: P16 offline UTF-8 parser and canonicalization
constraints: Immutable UTF-8 bytes, at most 65536 bytes and depth 8, duplicate decoded keys rejected.
Integer lexemes bounded before numeric conversion; floats, exponents and nonfinite tokens rejected.
Closed ASCII statement schema; deterministic application-subset canonicalization; no network or actuation.
Portable synchronous software API; no specified target hardware, hard deadline, throughput or RSS budget.
alternatives: CPython JSON token and object-pair hooks.
Rust Serde custom map visitor and numeric lexical adapter.
JavaScript JSON.parse with additional lexical validation.
rationale: Explicit UTF-8 decoding and raw integer/float/pair callbacks meet the lexical requirements without implementing a tokenizer.
Fourteen portable byte cases validate current behavior; removing duplicate rejection exposes two assertion failures. Default syntax parsers are not complete replacements.
Other documented APIs are credible alternatives, but no material improvement is established for this bounded offline contract. This is not a comparative performance ranking.
Installed tools, existing language, familiarity and rewrite cost are not selection criteria. No winning migration is deferred; no target-runtime decision is inferred.
limits: Only CPython current implementation and default CPython/Node syntax behavior were executed; other candidates were reviewed from primary documentation.
No general JCS implementation, whole-lane completion, hard real-time, CNSA, MLS or physical qualification.
The fourteen-case corpus supplements existing bounds/schema tests and is not exhaustive language equivalence.
